:::{#thm-deriv-dot-product}

#### Product rule for dot-products

If $\vecf{a} = \vecf{a}(\vx)$ and $\vecf{b} = \vecf{b}(\vx)$
are differentiable $p \times 1$ vector functions of $\vx$, then:

$$
\ba
\deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \dpf{\ubf{\vecf{a}}{p \times 1}}{\ubf{\vecf{b}}{p \times 1}}
&=
\paren{
    \deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \ubf{\tp{\vecf{a}}}{1 \times p}
  }
\ubf{\vecf{b}}{p \times 1}
+
\paren{
  \deriv{\ubf{\vx}{p \times 1}} \ubf{\tp{\vecf{b}}}{1 \times p}
}
\ubf{\vecf{a}}{p \times 1}
\ea
$$

:::
